description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to be the second MDS Coordinator on a team, working alongside a highly experienced lead. You will play a crucial role in patient assessment and care planning, contributing to the facility's commitment to quality.

This 148-bed facility maintains an average Med A census of 15-20 and recently achieved outstanding results in its annual survey, earning a 5-star rating for Quality Measures. Join a supportive environment where your expertise will be valued in maintaining high standards of care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in Florida
Minimum of 1 year of recent experience as an MDS Coordinator
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 and care planning processes
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations for skilled nursing facilities

description: Join a premier home health agency in Billings, MT, as a Registered Nurse (RN). This flexible opportunity offers both full-time and part-time options, allowing you to tailor your career to your lifestyle while providing essential care in a dynamic home setting. We are seeking dedicated professionals eager to make a direct impact on patient well-being.This role comes with a highly competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment. You will be an integral part of a team focused on delivering personalized, high-quality care to patients in their homes, fostering independence and improving health outcomes.
requirements: Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in home health or a related clinical setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $125,000 annually, based on experience and full-time or part-time status.
